observations: Apparent contradiction on when retrocausal canon formation was first formalized: PRED-102.D1 says 'first formalized 2025'; PRED-22.D1 and PRED-24.H4 cite 'Retrocausal Canon Formation and the Political Economy of the Past' deposited January 4, 2026; and the later statement F23.D1 of PRED-1251.D2 (deposit 23, 2026-02-27) says 'The term retrocausal canon formation is likewise unattested. These terms are defined here for the first time.' Recorded, not reconciled.

Registration date of PRED-1251.D2 (2026-01-17, deposit 1251) seems wrong for this find: deposit 1251 is a blog-canonical recovery whose source is the March 2026 DOI Registry v7.0 post, and the text registers 10.5281/zenodo.18807239 ('The Shark That Preceded Itself', deposit 23, 2026-02-27), which postdates January 17. The claim's earliest real statement is likely F23.D1 (2026-02-27).
PRED-646.E1 (outside this batch, related to PRED-58.D1 by the triage) belongs with the Kimberly-Clark series PRED-58.D1 / PRED-649.E4.
PRED-530.B3 (TP38.3, 'accelerates the semantic entropy spiral') belongs with PRED-521.E3, which states the spiral itself; left unlinked as a distinct claim about Unified Latents.

PRED-522.E1, PRED-522.E2, PRED-522.E3 and PRED-522.E5 are all from 'The Airlock Spreads', split across groups TP38.1, TP38.2 and TP38.3; PRED-521.E1 (TP38.1) is the scenario frame of the Ghost Meaning essay whose atlas is PRED-520.E* (TP38.3).
